how: Researched 25 Nov 2026 for the AI search (Joel: "add brunch hours and a price level"): from each restaurant's own site, then press and listings (never Google Maps, Instagram, TheFork, Tripadvisor or guide.michelin.com). brunch: weekdays with brunch or breakfast, [] none, null unknown. price: dinner per person without drinks, euros. level: 1 under 30, 2 30-60, 3 60-100, 4 over 100. Every known fact has its sources. Exploration: a first build, not checked against a second source; null means not found, never no.

alba.note: Own site (Nov 2026): Tu-Th 18-23, Fr-Sa 18-24, dinner only; a 2020 YLBB line about weekend brunch is out of date.

bacalar.note: Home page only: no hours, no menu prices. /menu returned 404.

badcuyp.note: Homepage hours Mo-Sa 17:30-00:00 only. No prices on site.

bak.note: Homepage: lunch Sa and Su stated; no breakfast or brunch line; no per-person prices. Price: OpenTable diner: seven course taster menu was EUR 50, plus about EUR 27 wine pairing; Michelin EUR EUR EUR

bar-centraal.note: Site has hours only (Mo 17-24, Fr 13-01), menu as PDF links, no tags.

barracuda.note: Prices in a sample-menu PDF, not read. Hours on a separate contact page, not read.

bisous.note: Hours Wed-Sat 17:30-01:00 only. Menu is a PDF, not read. Vibe: 'intimate French-Zeeland restaurant and bar', 'Parisian Chic'.

bistro-de-la-mer.note: Full hours stated (lunch 12:00-14:30 and dinner 17:30-22:00 Mo-Su), no breakfast or brunch. No prices or vibe text.

bolenius.note: Site shows Valentine menus at 125 (no currency, special menu, not typical) so price left null. Lunch on 14.02 only (Valentine). Michelin not read (search snippet only). Price: The six-course menu is just €99, which makes it the best value-to-prestige ratio on this list.

bon-burger.note: Home page only: no hours, no menu.

bon-burger-noord.note: Page read but restaurant name on the page was not checked; hours Wed-Sun 17:00-23:00, kitchen closes 22:00. Verify the page is the Noord branch.

boon-de-koot.note: Dinner hours only (Mo-Th 17:30-24:00, Fr-Sa 16:00-24:00, Su closed). Menu is a PDF, not read.

bottleshop.note: Site gives tags only, no menu prices.

bougainville.note: Footer lists only Mo-Su 18:30-22:00. No prices on page.

vibe: bar menu with oysters and charcuterie
cafe-binnenvisser.note: Site returned only the name 'binnenvisser' (no hours, no menu), also on /menu. Nothing read.

cafe-caron.note: Price = cheapest to dearest starter (10-17) plus main (26.50-33), from listed dishes; not a stated per-person price. Lunch Sa and Su (lunch menu). Hours start 12:00.

cafe-de-klepel.note: 3-course 54,50 and 4-course 64,50 menus (changing daily, no dish names).

cafe-modern.note: Lunch only as summer terrace lunch, no days. Area on search: Meidoornweg, Noord (page not checked).

cafe-parlotte.note: Weekend opening from 13:00, weekdays drinks from 16:00 and dinner from 17:00. No prices. Brunch [] is inferred from opening hours, not stated. Vibe: 'gezelligheid', 'Mooie wijn, lekker eten'.

cafe-restaurant-amsterdam.note: Site redirects to cradam.nl (Cradam). Hours and lunch PDF listed; menu PDFs not readable. Daily 10:00-24:00 per Cradam page; no breakfast or brunch stated.

cafe-wu.note: Hours Tue-Sat from 18:00 only. Price = chef's menu 4 courses EUR 58, 5 courses EUR 66.

calisto.note: Homepage returned only the title 'calisto: restaurant & hotel'; /restaurant gave the same. Nothing read.

carmen.note: Page: café serves breakfast and lunch; kitchen hours Mo-Th 9:30-14:30, Fr-Su 9:30-15:00. Breakfast day split not stated per weekday, so all days assumed from the kitchen hours. Verify.

choux.note: Site is a greeting and navigation only. Search snippets (not read) mention a one-star vegetarian tasting menu; not used. Price: The five-course tasting is €82.50, with a three-course Theatre menu at €52.50 for an early seat. (list updated 20 Jun 2026)

ciel-bleu.note: Entry Tue-Sat 18:30-20:00 only. Menu names given, no prices. Price: about €225 to €275, excluding drinks (2026 ranking); a 2026 guide gives menus from €215

copain.note: Hours Wo-Za 18:00-22:00 only, Zo-Di no hours. Mains EUR 24 a la carte, chef's menu 4 courses EUR 54. Level null: range spans levels 1-2.

cornerstore.note: Dinner Wed-Sat; lunch only on the first Sunday of the month. No breakfast or brunch. Menu prices not shown. Price: roughly €8 to €15 per person (aggregator estimate, generic, not from the menu)

cue.note: Lunch only on Sunday ('Sunday lunch, bookings from 13:00'). Menus named without prices.

dame-aan-de-kade.note: Opening hours start 15:00 (Fri-Sun) or 17:00. Food menu is a linked PDF/image, not read.

de-kas.note: Menu page: Lunch 3 courses EUR 55, 4 courses EUR 67, 5 courses EUR 76; Dinner 5 courses EUR 86, 6 courses EUR 95. Menu page lists lunch and dinner only, no brunch. Homepage tagline 'In de ochtend geoogst, In de middag op het bord'. Price basis (per person) not stated on page. Search snippets (not read) gave different lunch prices.

elan.note: Home page only: no hours, no menu, no prices.

entrepot.note: Footer hours only: MA-ZA 18:00-01:00. No lunch or breakfast shown. Lunch false rests on this footer alone.

euro-pizza.note: Site has no prices; menu as PDF.

europa.note: Hours Do/Vr/Za 18:30 only. Menu page 404. Price: Choose from a five or seven course tasting menu (89 and 105 EUR). (Roadbook, guide updated 9 Jul 2026; level 3 from the 89 menu, the 105 menu is level 4)

fa-pekelhaaring.note: Hours Tu-Su 12:00-22:00, 'voor lunch & diner'; no breakfast or brunch stated. Price: a la carte per dish, starter+main computed as lowest antipasto 15.5 + lowest primo 17.5 = 33, and highest antipasto 17.5 + highest secondo 29.5 = 47. Not a menu price.

flore.note: Lunch Fri and Sat 12:00-16:00. Price = tasting menu 250 pp (Omnivore and Herbivore; wine pairing 120 pp). Mo, Tu, Su hours not stated.

franzen.note: Lunch Wed-Sat 12.00-14.30 per site. No prices (PDF).

fuku-ramen.note: Price = 6-course seasonal tasting menu. Sat 13:00-19:30 a la carte, not labelled lunch. No morning service listed.

gebr-hartering.note: Site: 'open daily from 18:00', no lunch or brunch times. Address Peperstraat 10hs. No prices read. Price: OpenTable puts it at €30 and under per person. Michelin: €€. Amsterdam Foodie: €€€ (conflict).

gitane.note: Page says open daily from 10, no weekday or service detail, no prices. Price: one guest reports a bill of €40 per person (single review, bill may include drinks)

helling-7.note: Lunch Sa and Su 12-15 per site ('Lunch Zaterdag & Zondag 12:00-15:00'). Sunday hours from 12 not named as brunch.

hoi-tin.note: Open every day 12:00-22:00, not labelled lunch. Prices in menu PDFs, not read. Price: average meal 20 - 30 EUR (directory listing); Time Out: Price: Mid-range

hotel-de-goudfazant.note: Menu page: 'We serveren drie gangen voor EUR 49,50', changes often, fish/meat/vegan/vegetarian; a la carte prices not listed. Homepage and menu page give no opening hours, so lunch and brunch unknown.

ikaria-park.note: Site not readable: certificate error on https://www.ikariapark.nl and http://www.ikariapark.nl. Search snippets only (not fetched); not used. Price: €18 to €45 per person (Mapthemeal aggregator); Amsterdam Sights: €€

kaagman-kortekaas.note: Brunch [] and lunch false from site: kitchen open Tue-Sat 18-22, closed Sun and Mon. Set menus 4/5/6 courses at 69,50/79,50/89,50.

kamer-bar.note: Hours not on pages read. Menu prices only in an image.

ken-sushi.note: Omakase Experience EUR 80 p.p., Advanced EUR 150 p.p., drinks extra. Hours Wed-Sun 17:00-00:00, seatings 17:30 and 20:30. Reservations online only. Level 3 uses the Experience menu; Advanced would be level 4.

kid-amsterdam.note: Coffee Fri-Su 10:00-16:30 and lunch Fri-Su 11:30-16:30 stated; page never says brunch or breakfast. Listed prices are single dishes only (plie 27, shared steak 94).

kims-so-korean-food.note: No site in batch. Search results only (snippets, pages not read), no prices or menu found. Not used.

kiri.note: Lunch Tue-Fri 12:00-14:00 and first Sunday of month. Only lunch service listed. Bento EUR 74 and 78 are special menus; standard price not stated.

la-vallade.note: Hours Mo-Su 17:30-21:00 only. Menu page: 4-course vegetarian menu EUR 38.50, meat or fish supplement EUR 11.50 (high = 50). Page does not say per person. Terrace: 'Bij mooi weer serveren onze wekelijks wisselende menu's ... op het terras'.

marie.note: Lunch Mo-Fr 12:00-14:00, Sa-Su 12:30-14:00; dinner daily 18:00-21:00. No breakfast or brunch. Menus are flippingbook PDFs, not read.

meneer-de-wit-heeft-honger.note: Own site http://www.meneerdewitheefthonger.nl returned 404 (both http and https). iAmsterdam lists Wed-Sun 18:00-22:00 only, no brunch or lunch stated: brunch [] and lunch false rest on those hours alone. No prices found.

mesa-mesa.note: Sat open 12:00, Sun 12:00; lunch not labelled. No prices. Price: price range €31 to €50 (OpenTable listing)

nikotin.note: Hours Wed-Sat from 18:00, Sun from 13:00, no morning service listed. Bar 'always open for walk-in'. Food menu is a Google Drive link, not read. Brunch [] inferred from hours.

nk-thai-noodles.note: Hours Mo-Sa 12:00-22:00, Su closed. Price = main dish only (Krapao 18.50 to Pad Thai 20.50), not a full meal. Lunch from the Visit Us text.

nnea.note: Brunch [] and lunch false rest on site hours '7 days open from 17:30' only. 'Strictly NO CASH POLICY' stated.

omi.note: Dinner Tue-Sat from 17:00 only. No prices on page.

restaurant-212.note: Lunch Wed-Sat 12:00-13:30, dinner Tu-Sat 18:30-21:00. No brunch or breakfast listed. No menu prices read.

restaurant-kyo.note: Contact hours 17:00-00:00 daily and dinner-only wording, but the COVID notice on the page is dated 2020, so hours may be stale. Per-dish prices only (3.55-33.95). Price: average price for a meal 29 - 43 EUR (Intravel directory)

restobar-massalia.note: Hours Mo-Th 16-00, Fr 16-01, Sa-Su 12-00/01; no lunch or brunch stated.

rijsel.note: Hours Mon-Fri 18:00-22:00 only. Price = starter 17.50 + main 31.50 (from) to 3-course a la carte 58.50, wine excluded.

vibe: a la carte or 3-5 course menu
roef.note: Open Tu-Sa from 11:00, Su-Mo closed. Text: 'een goeie koffie, een lekkere lunch of een avond tafelen'. Morning service not clear, so brunch null. No prices.

roux.note: Hours not on the page. Menu page content truncated; no prices read. Price: 3 courses EUR 50,- / 4 courses EUR 70,- / 5 courses EUR 85,- (chef's menu, per person)

scheepskameel.note: Hours Tue-Sat from 18:00 only. No prices. Price: AmsterdamNow estimates a four-course menu at about €52 per person (article undated).

sinck.note: Sunday lunch ('op zondag ... lunch of vroeg diner'). Mo-Sa lunch 'op aanvraag' (on request), so lunch true is for Sunday only.

sinne.note: Lunch Sat and Sun 12:00-16:00. Menu prices not on page. Price: four courses €85, five courses €105, six courses €125 (review dated 7 Feb 2026)

tannay.note: Chef's menu EUR 74 or EUR 89 p.p. (9 Oct to 29 Nov). Lunch Sat and Sun 12:30-14:00 per page. Dinner Wed-Sun. Menu from 2 Dec has no price.

taste-of-culture.note: No site on record. Search results (not fetched) put it at Korte Leidsedwarsstraat, not De Weteringschans; address and hours unconfirmed. Not used. Price: prices range from €12 to €25 per person (one guide estimate; not verified, the restaurant's page returned 403)

twee-prinsen.note: Site gives hours and door policy only, no menu.

vin-fou.note: Sat/Sun open 12:00, Mon-Thu 15:30. No prices. Walk-in stated.

vrr.note: Dinner Tu-Sa from 18:00; Sun and Mo not stated. Lunch only as special events (Sun 29 Nov, 1 Jan). Diner de Quartier 29.50 for main, bread, salad and dessert, per person not stated, so price left null.

watergang.note: Lunch Fr, Sa, Su from 12.30. Five-course surprise menu 74 (dinner). Four-course lunch 62 on Fr-Su (not used for price range).

weinlokal-stern.note: Lunch Sunday only, 12:30-14:00. Wine card EUR 38-75 is drinks; dish prices not stated.

wils.note: Page shows only the name 'Wils Restaurant & Wils Bakery Café' and navigation. No hours, menu or prices. Nothing read.

xiang.note: Hours Su-Th 12:00-22:30, Fr-Sa 12:00-23:30; no lunch stated. Dishes are shared-style plates (18.90-25.90 main, 9.90 egg), so no per-person figure.

zoldering.note: Fetched page mixed with content for Lof, de Wijnwinkel and Boon & de Koot; cannot tell which is Zoldering. Only 'keuken tot 22:00' Fri-Sat found; not read as lunch. Needs a second look.
